faqs.q: Is it Shepard or Shepherd Excavating?
faqs.a: Our family name is Shepard, but folks often write it as Shepherd Excavating. Both point to the same business: Shepard Excavating and Septic Service, LLC, based in Laporte, MN.

faqs.q: How often should I have my septic tank pumped?
faqs.a: Most experts recommend having your septic system pumped every two to three years. Give us a call and we will get you on the schedule at a fair rate.

faqs.q: Are you a licensed septic installer?
faqs.a: Yes. We are an MPCA-certified septic installer with more than 20 years of experience. We handle the whole process: drawing up the septic design, applying for county permits, the installation, and the final inspection.
We serve Northern Minnesota across Beltrami, Hubbard, and Cass counties, including Bemidji, Laporte, Park Rapids, Walker, Cass Lake, Hackensack, Longville, and the surrounding lake country.

faqs.q: Can you thaw frozen septic and water lines?
faqs.a: Yes. We steam frozen septic and water lines and clear sewer backups with our rooter and line-cleaning service. Call (218) 224-2754 during business hours to schedule service.

faqs.q: What kinds of sand and gravel do you sell?
faqs.a: Fill sand, screened topsoil, Class 5 gravel, crushed concrete, 1½-inch washed rock, and boulders. We can deliver it and spread it for you, and we will source other materials on request.

faqs.q: Can one company really handle all of this?
faqs.a: That is the whole idea. Septic, excavating, land clearing, demolition, sand and gravel, and snow removal, all under one roof since 1997. One call instead of juggling four contractors.
